paper.title: Algorithm 776: SRRIT, a Fortran subroutine to calculate the dominant invariant subspace of a nonsymmetric matrix (ACM TOMS 23(4), 1997)

field: numerics (dominant invariant subspace and eigenvalues of a nonsymmetric matrix, subspace iteration with Ritz refinement)
stack: Fortran 77 (netlib TOMS 776.gz: shell archive with Doc/, Drivers/Dp, Drivers/Sp, Src/Dp, Src/Sp; the double-precision driver and routines are Drivers/Dp/driver.f and Src/Dp/dsrrit.f, dblas.f, dlapack.f)

claim.text: WR, first converged real eigenvalue, of the seeded problem printed by the authors' double-precision driver, registered as -1235.506919564 (tol_abs 1e-6), located by the scout in the shipped reference Doc DRES as the 'RWK' block of a 496 by 496 matrix. The located value is NOT in the RWK block; see result.md. Registered by scout in the queue entry (fcdf386).

attempt: Original attempt (G1): the authors' documented build (Doc/Makefile, epcf90 -sloppy -C -d1 -g) fails because epcf90 is not installed in the sandbox (make exit 2). Patch (compiler substitution only): the authors' double-precision driver and routines Drivers/Dp/driver.f, Src/Dp/dsrrit.f, dblas.f, dlapack.f are compiled unmodified with gfortran 16 -O2 and linked (build-only: manifests pre and mid are identical). The run prints a converged eigenvalue for each problem block. The run's BWM block (test matrix size 200, seeded by the driver) gives WR = -1.235506919564D+03 at the same digits as the shipped DRES line 260, and the RWK block (test matrix size 496) gives first WR = 1.000000000000D+00. The registered claim names the RWK 496 by 496 problem, so the claim as written does not match the value it points to. Verdict blocked: the claim is mis-specified (location and problem identity). The claim and tolerance are not edited here; see note-to-scout.md.

original_attempt.reason: The authors' documented make target calls epcf90, which is not installed in the sandbox (make: epcf90: No such file or directory). The authors' own compiler is not available to this plant.

blocked_on.missing: a claim whose registered location matches the value: -1235.506919564 is printed by the BWM block (test matrix size 200), while the registered metric says RWK 496 by 496 (RWK prints WR 1.000000000000D+00 first). Resolver: scout (queue entry revision in a new commit, or withdrawal). Bounded action: scout checks reports/bai1997-srrit-776/result.md and note-to-scout.md, then revises the claim's metric and location, or withdraws it. Disposition: when the scout's revision commit appears, rerun reruns against it on the next wake.

build_commands: gfortran -O2 driver.o dsrrit.o dblas.o dlapack.o -o dsubspiter
